title: Weak saturation in each variable of the pushout-join property
statement:
Use simplicial sets and horns of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. A class of simplicial maps is weakly saturated if it contains all isomorphisms and is closed under pushouts, transfinite compositions and retracts. Inner anodyne maps are the weakly saturated class generated by $\Lambda_j^m\hookrightarrow\Delta^m$ for $0<j<m$. The join $X\star Y$ has $r$-simplices $X_r\amalg Y_r\amalg\coprod_{u,v\geq0,\ u+v+1=r}X_u\times Y_v$, with simplicial operators restricting the ordered concatenation of the $X$-vertices followed by the $Y$-vertices. For monomorphisms $i:A\hookrightarrow B$ and $k:K\hookrightarrow L$, write
$$\theta_{i,k}:(A\star L)\amalg_{A\star K}(B\star K)\longrightarrow B\star L.$$
For each fixed monomorphism $k$, the class of monomorphisms $i$ for which $\theta_{i,k}$ is inner anodyne is weakly saturated. For each fixed monomorphism $i$, the class of monomorphisms $k$ for which $\theta_{i,k}$ is inner anodyne is weakly saturated.
